risks.risk: Exact model/capacity is unknown, which strongly affects price and parts availability.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/model sticker (usually on the back or inside the lid) showing model number and capacity (kg).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used top-loading washing machine with unknown capacity (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (may have weak spin, drainage issues, or non-start).
risks.proof: Short video of a full wash cycle starting and completing (including spin/drain) or a clear test run with water filling and draining.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs service).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (drain hose, inlet hose, power cable condition) can add cost.
risks.proof: Photos showing the full set: drain hose, inlet hose, power cord, and any accessories/attachments laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming hoses/accessories may be missing or worn (worst-case: buyer may need replacements).

risks.risk: Physical condition (dents, rust, leaks) is not fully visible from this single front shot.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and close-ups of the bottom edge, corners, and any rust/leak stains.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible cosmetic wear (worst-case: no premium for appearance).

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate/model sticker (back or inside) showing model number and capacity (kg).
Video of a complete wash cycle (start → wash → spin → drain).
Photos of drain hose, inlet hose, and power cord (condition and included items).
Photos of the back panel and bottom edge for leaks/rust.
response.reason: From the photo, the brand “NEXUS” is visible, but the model/capacity and working condition are not. Without a test run and the model/rating plate, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
